PNJ-12.ambicion: For someone to acknowledge that he was Vance's son too.
convicciones: Never hit someone who can't hit back
ventajas: Resources 1 (what Halloway pays him)
Haven 1 (a barge in dry dock in Georgetown)
Mask 0 (forged papers for a Portuguese passport)
equipo: Vance's coat: a long gray wool overcoat, tailored for a man broader in the shoulders (DOC-06, DOC-10)
Copy 2 of 3 of Vance's journals (DOC-04), with his pencil notes
Support from Halloway: an electric car with no registered plates, and two security ghouls (MEN-04) if he asks for them
PNJ-12.cita: “He taught you to stop the blow. He taught me to take it.”
PNJ-12.semblante: Looks about twenty-eight, though he moves like an older man. Shaved head, a knife scar through his left eyebrow, a broken nose that healed badly; dark work clothes under Vance's coat. He's left-handed.
PNJ-12.nota: Editor's Note: doc 07 said “looks about thirty-five”; his age at the Embrace was settled on instead (about 28). Doc 07 gave him five powers with Potence 4 and four with Celerity 3; Spark of Rage (an amalgam that requires Presence 3; Krell has 2) and Rapid Reflexes (the Celerity power the adventure doesn't use) were removed, one per dot.
provisional: Krell is Vance's childe (David's blood brother).

PNJ-17.ambicion: For the truth about 1978 to be on the record.
convicciones: Nobody gets left alone in the alley
A badge is a promise, not a license

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: His best boxer, 19 years old, whom he's preparing for her first professional fight.

ventajas: Herd 1 and Allies 1 (the gym kids: young boxers who think he's an old trainer with insomnia)
Contacts 2 (the Port of Tacoma and old retired longshoremen)
Haven 2 (the Shamrock gym, Port of Tacoma)
Mask 2
equipo: DOC-08: the original letter, kept in a plastic sleeve under the ring
PNJ-17.cita: “I wore this badge before there was a port. They took it from me with three photos.”
PNJ-17.semblante: Looks about thirty-one. Huge and round-shouldered, red hair and a short beard, a broken nose and cauliflower ears; undershirt, suspenders, and a wool cap.
PNJ-17.nota: Editor's Note: doc 07 said “looks about fifty” and “graying red hair”; his age at the Embrace was settled on instead (about 31, red hair with no gray).

PNJ-11.sire: An Anarch from the shipyard, who disappeared in 1999
PNJ-11.ambicion: For Everett to be a free domain recognized by everyone.
convicciones: Nobody uses a minor as herd
Decisions get put to a vote

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: The oldest welder in the shipyard, who has kept the night shift for her since 1989.

ventajas: Allies 3 and Herd 2 (the union: loyal longshoremen and welders)
Influence 2 (the Port of Everett and the naval base)
Haven 2 (a ship's hull in dry dock, Everett's old shipyard, LUG-10)
Mask 2
Salt's Anarchs (COT-03; MEN-05): some fifteen Kindred
PNJ-11.cita: “Nobody kisses rings here. Here, we weld.”
PNJ-11.semblante: Short and compact, short black hair, welding burns on her forearms; blue work coveralls with her name embroidered on them and steel-toed boots.

PNJ-20.apodo: She Who Doesn't Know What She Carries
PNJ-20.ambicion: Not to die in some doorway.

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: Her grandmother, who runs a flower shop in the International District and reads her fortune in tea leaves.

ventajas: Day Drinker, thin-blood Merit
Contacts 2 (delivery riders across half the city)
Haven 0
Mask 3 (she has a legal life, bank accounts, and a family)
equipo: The bike: electric, modified, the fastest in the underground
The USB drive: a partial copy of the File, with the folders from 2019 to 2022
PNJ-20.cita: “I just deliver. I don't open the packages. That's rule number one.”
PNJ-20.semblante: Slight and wiry, faded blue-dyed hair, piercings; yellow waterproof delivery jacket, insulated backpack, and a helmet covered in stickers.

PNJ-18.concepto: FIRSTLIGHT, head of the Puget Cell; latent antagonist
ventajas: Unshakable Faith (Dominate and Presence take −2 dice against her; if they fail, she notices)
Contacts 3 (FBI, Homeland Security, Seattle police)
Resources 3 (federal budget)
equipo: Glock 19 pistol with incendiary ammunition (aggravated damage against Kindred)
PNJ-18.cita: “Every source wants something. Until you know what, it's bait.”
PNJ-18.semblante: Forty-five. Tall, close-cropped graying hair, gray blazer; her left hand is missing the ring and little fingers, and she keeps it in her pocket almost all the time.

ventajas: Faith (−1 die to mental Disciplines against her)

PNJ-19.concepto: Halloway's ghoul, CEO of Gale Sentinel
defectos: His dose of Vitae is three days overdue: −1 die to everything until he gets it.
PNJ-19.semblante: Early fifties, investor-pitch smile, talks in slogans.

PJ-01.concepto: Former Navy commando Embraced in Haiti in 1960 by Marcus Vance, now the Seattle Sheriff's outside enforcer.
PJ-01.secta: independent, operational ally of the Camarilla
PJ-01.ambicion: Keep the balance between the Kindred and the Masquerade.
PJ-01.deseo: Root out those who break the veil, even if they're old allies.
convicciones: The Masquerade is the last shield between order and chaos.
Only the monster you know can be controlled.
I don't hunt out of hate, but for balance.

piedrasDeToque.descripcion: Alive (PNJ-04). Human journalist, a source of information on supernatural events.
Lost, 1996 (REF-01). His daughter; lost Anchor: occasional Remorse tests and nightmares.
Ghoul ex-SEAL (PNJ-05); loyal, but dependent on his Vitae. The sheet lists him as a Touchstone; docs 00–16 treat him as an anchor, even though he's a ghoul.

ventajas: Ally 4 (the Sheriff of Seattle): trust and direct collaboration
Haven 3 (the Harbor Island hangar, LUG-01; with Maritime Access and Armory). The earlier sheet gives Secure Haven 4: armored, tunnel access
Contacts 3 (Police / ex-military ghouls): information network
Resources 3 (military contraband): weapons, vehicles, tactical tech
Hidden Fame 3 (“The Black Dog of the Masquerade”)
Iron Will 3: reroll one Willpower test per scene
defectos: Pent-Up Rage 2: +2 Difficulty to resist Brujah Compulsions in combat
War Scars 2: inhuman appearance under direct light
Moral Hardliner 1: refuses to cooperate with those who use the Beast as an excuse
War Dreams (Embrace trauma) 2: −1 to the first Resolve or Composure test after waking if his self-control failed
Dependent Relationship (Tom “Bear” Whitman) 1: if the ghoul is captured or hurt, he loses his composure or risks frenzy
Distrust of Magic / Tremere: refuses to work with sorcery or Blood rituals
Lost Anchor (dead Touchstone): his daughter died and he feels guilty
equipo: Black tactical jacket with the insignia removed
Old military knife (a keepsake from his mortal life; he was carrying it the day of his Embrace)
PJ-01.cita: “Some have to burn so the rest can see the light.”
PJ-01.semblante: Square, tense jaw, a scar from his right cheekbone to his lip, short dark hair graying at the temples, dark gray eyes that are almost black; black tactical jacket with no insignia; he smells of gunpowder, rust, and dried blood.
PJ-01.nota: Editor's Note: adjusted to V5. Rapid Reflexes drops to level 1; Lightning Strike (level 5) doesn't fit with Celerity 4 and was swapped for Blink (level 3); Blurred Momentum (homebrew) stays at level 3, with a homemade description in the profile.
provisional: David arrived in Seattle in the '80s.

PNJ-04.apodo: She Who Looks Where She Shouldn't
PNJ-04.concepto: Investigative journalist and host of “What the City Forgets”
ventajas: Contacts: three in the police (earlier source, no rating)
equipo: Flip phone with a single number: SAFE (DOC-05)
PNJ-04.semblante: Wry, sarcastic, smokes too much, sleeps too little; wears glasses when she's exhausted, but won't admit it. Talks fast and listens better.

PNJ-05.concepto: David's ghoul; ex-SEAL and the hangar's armorer
equipo: Black metal canteen of Vitae, always in his backpack
A weapon in his personal safe in the hangar (with note DOC-12)
PNJ-05.cita: “No kids. No people who didn't do anything. No killing just because.”
PNJ-05.semblante: Huge, late forties; says little, dry barracks humor; a wrecked knee that barely hurts him anymore.
